records.jp: あれ？　みんなで何話してるの？
records.en_original: Oh, hey. What are you all talking about?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, hey. What are you all talking about?
records.en: Huh? What are you all talking about?

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん！　<CR>あのね、花壇に新しい花を植えたいんだけど……
records.en_original: Hey Ao! So, we were thinking about planting some new flowers in the garden, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Hey Ao! So, we were thinking about planting some new flowers in the garden, but...
records.en: Ao-chan!<CR>So, we want to plant some new flowers in the flower bed, but...

records.jp: どんな花がいいかなぁって、話してたんだぁ
records.en_original: We just can't decide on what kind of flowers to plant.
records.en_auxiliary: We just can't decide on what kind of flowers to plant.
records.en: we were talking about what kind of flowers would be nice.

records.jp: へぇ……そういえば最近、<CR>なんだか花壇が綺麗になってる気がする
records.en_original: Huh. Come to think of it, the garden has been looking pretty nice lately.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh. Come to think of it, the garden has been looking pretty nice lately.
records.en: Oh... Now that you mention it,<CR>I feel like the flower bed has gotten prettier lately.

records.jp: あ、それはね。詩ちゃんが――
records.en_original: Oh, that's because Uta has been—
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, that's because Uta has been—
records.en: Ah, that is because Uta-chan—

records.jp: い、いえ。私より、陽桜莉さんと美弦さんが<CR>手伝って下さったからで……
records.en_original: N-no. I-it's all thanks to Hiori and Mio for helping me tend it.
records.en_auxiliary: N-no. I-it's all thanks to Hiori and Mio for helping me tend it.
records.en: N-no. More than me, it is because<CR>Hiori-san and Mio-san helped me...

records.jp: ……？　えっと、つまり？
records.en_original: ...Sorry, I'm a little lost.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Sorry, I'm a little lost.
records.en: ...? Um, in other words?

records.jp: 最初はね、詩ちゃんが花壇のお世話を<CR>ひとりで一生懸命やってたんだ～
records.en_original: Well first, Mio and I saw that Uta was taking care of the garden on her own.
records.en_auxiliary: Well first, Mio and I saw that Uta was taking care of the garden on her own.
records.en: At first, Uta-chan was taking care of the flower bed<CR>all by herself and working really hard at it~

records.jp: でね、お姉ちゃんと一緒にお手伝いしようって<CR>なって、そしたらすっごく楽しくて……
records.en_original: So we decided to help her out, but then we got really into it.
records.en_auxiliary: So we decided to help her out, but then we got really into it.
records.en: Then Onee-chan and I decided we should help,<CR>and it ended up being really fun...

records.jp: もっと賑やかにしようって話になって、<CR>新しく花を植えたいねーってなったんだ～
records.en_original: Then we all thought we should plant more flowers, so we started discussing what to plant.
records.en_auxiliary: Then we all thought we should plant more flowers, so we started discussing what to plant.
records.en: Then we started saying we should make it livelier,<CR>and that we wanted to plant some new flowers~

records.jp: へぇ……なんか素敵だね、詩さん！<CR>でも、どうしてひとりで花壇の世話してたの？
records.en_original: Wow... That's really cool, Uta! But why were you tending the garden by yourself in the first place?
records.en_auxiliary: Wow... That's really cool, Uta! But why were you tending the garden by yourself in the first place?
records.en: Oh... That is kind of lovely, Uta-san!<CR>But why were you taking care of the flower bed by yourself?

records.jp: ……罪滅ぼし、でしょうか
records.en_original: ...Atonement, I suppose.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Atonement, I suppose.
records.en: ...Atonement, perhaps.

records.jp: 過去の私が犯したこと……みなさんとの交流が<CR>上手くできず、迷惑をかけてばかりなこと……
records.en_original: For the things I've done in the past... The trouble I've caused because of my inability to interact with you properly...
records.en_auxiliary: For the things I've done in the past... The trouble I've caused because of my inability to interact with you properly...
records.en: For what my past self did...<CR>for always causing trouble because I could not interact well with all of you...

records.jp: 詩さん……そんなの、一人で抱えないで――
records.en_original: Uta... You don't need to—
records.en_auxiliary: Uta... You don't need to—
records.en: Uta-san... You do not have to carry all of that alone—

records.jp: ……それだけではありません
records.en_original: That isn't all.
records.en_auxiliary: That isn't all.
records.en: ...That is not all.

records.jp: もう一人の私……過去の私が現れて、<CR>この生活を壊し始めるのではないか……
records.en_original: I fear that my other self...the one from my past...will reemerge and destroy this life we share.
records.en_auxiliary: I fear that my other self...the one from my past...will reemerge and destroy this life we share.
records.en: That another me... my past self, might appear<CR>and begin destroying this life...

records.jp: 今でもそれが心配で……<CR>その気持ちを落ち着けるためにやっている面もあります
records.en_original: I can't stop worrying about that, so...another reason I tend the garden is to keep my mind off of such thoughts.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't stop worrying about that, so...another reason I tend the garden is to keep my mind off of such thoughts.
records.en: I still worry about that even now...<CR>Part of why I do this is to calm those feelings.

records.jp: そっか……。<CR>詩さん、頑張ってるんだね
records.en_original: I see... You have a lot on your shoulders, don't you?
records.en_auxiliary: I see... You have a lot on your shoulders, don't you?
records.en: I see...<CR>You are doing your best, Uta-san.

records.jp: 私のそんな身勝手な行為に、陽桜莉さんたちは<CR>付き合ってくれたんです
records.en_original: Hiori and Mio were kind enough to lend a hand to my selfish ritual.
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori and Mio were kind enough to lend a hand to my selfish ritual.
records.en: Hiori-san and the others went along<CR>with such a selfish act of mine.

records.jp: だ～か～ら～、身勝手なんかじゃないって～！<CR>詩ちゃんがしてることは、いいことだよ！
records.en_original: I told you before, there's nothing selfish about it! What you're doing is a good thing!
records.en_auxiliary: I told you before, there's nothing selfish about it! What you're doing is a good thing!
records.en: Thaaat is why I am saying it is not selfish~!<CR>What you are doing, Uta-chan, is a good thing!

records.jp: ええ。「あの」詩が選べなかったこと……<CR>自罰的になる必要はないわ
records.en_original: Yes. You don't need to punish yourself for the choices that the other Uta couldn't make.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. You don't need to punish yourself for the choices that the other Uta couldn't make.
records.en: Yes. There is no need to become self-punishing<CR>over what "that" Uta could not choose.

records.jp: 詩さん、私もそう思うな。<CR>詩さんはすごく強い人だと思うよ
records.en_original: I think so too. You're a very strong person, Uta.
records.en_auxiliary: I think so too. You're a very strong person, Uta.
records.en: Uta-san, I think so too.<CR>I think you are a very strong person.

records.jp: それが本当だとしたら……私を受け入れてくれた<CR>みなさんがいるからだと思います
records.en_original: If that is true, it is only because of everybody accepting me for who I am.
records.en_auxiliary: If that is true, it is only because of everybody accepting me for who I am.
records.en: If that is true... I think it is because<CR>all of you accepted me.

records.jp: ……さて。今は花壇にどんな色の花を植えるか<CR>話し合っていたところなんです
records.en_original: Anyway, I believe we were discussing what color flower we'd like to plant.
records.en_auxiliary: Anyway, I believe we were discussing what color flower we'd like to plant.
records.en: ...Now then. We were just discussing<CR>what color flowers to plant in the flower bed.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんは桃色の花、美弦さんは青い花、<CR>そして私は紫色が良いかなと……
records.en_original: Hiori wanted pink flowers, Mio wanted blue ones, and I thought violet would be nice.
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori wanted pink flowers, Mio wanted blue ones, and I thought purple would be nice.
records.en: Hiori-san wants pink flowers, Mio-san wants blue flowers,<CR>and I was thinking purple might be nice...

records.jp: 星崎さん。<CR>新しい花は、どんな色の花がいいと思いますか？
records.en_original: Which color do you think would be best, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Which color do you think would be best, Ao?
records.en: Hoshizaki-san.<CR>What color flowers do you think would be good to plant next?

records.jp: んー。陽桜莉さんに賛成で、桃色の花かなぁ。<CR>桃色がいいって、陽桜莉さんらしいよね
records.en_original: Hmm... I think I'm with Hiori on this one. Pink is such a Hiori choice!
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... I think I'm with Hiori on this one. Pink is such a Hiori choice!
records.en: Hmm. I think I agree with Hiori-san—pink flowers, maybe.<CR>Saying pink suits you feels very Hiori-san, doesn't it?

records.jp: 何より、優しくてあったかい花壇になる気がする！
records.en_original: I think it'll give the garden a nice, warm tone!
records.en_auxiliary: I think it'll give the garden a nice, warm tone!
records.en: More than anything, I feel like it would make the flower bed gentle and warm!

records.jp: うんうん！　でしょ～！<CR>私、桃色の花って大好きなんだ～！
records.en_original: Right?! I just love pink flowers!
records.en_auxiliary: Right?! I just love pink flowers!
records.en: Mm-hmm! Right~!?<CR>I just love pink flowers~!

records.jp: 桃色の花は、あったかくて、陽桜莉さんらしい……
records.en_original: Pink flowers do feel warm, somehow. Just like Hiori.
records.en_auxiliary: Pink flowers do feel warm, somehow. Just like Hiori.
records.en: Pink flowers are warm, and very Hiori-san-like...

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんだと思って大事に育てることにします
records.en_original: I will care for them as though they were you.
records.en_auxiliary: I will care for them as though they were you.
records.en: I will cherish them as if they were you, Hiori-san.

records.jp: え。そんな風に言われると、照れるよぉ……
records.en_original: D-don't say it like that. You're making me blush.
records.en_auxiliary: D-don't say it like that. You're making me blush.
records.en: Eh. If you say it like that, I will blush...

records.jp: じゃあ、美弦さんイチオシの青い花！
records.en_original: How about blue flowers like Mio suggested?
records.en_auxiliary: How about blue flowers like Mio suggested?
records.en: Then blue flowers, Mio-san's top pick!

records.jp: 青い花なら、花壇の雰囲気を<CR>きりっと引き締めてくれそう！
records.en_original: Blue flowers would make the garden feel refined and neat!
records.en_auxiliary: Blue flowers would make the garden feel refined and neat!
records.en: Blue flowers feel like they would crisply sharpen<CR>the mood of the flower bed!

records.jp: ええ。他のみんなの目も楽しませてくれる<CR>と思うわ
records.en_original: Yes, and I do think everyone else would enjoy them as well.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, and I do think everyone else would enjoy them as well.
records.en: Yes. I think they would delight<CR>everyone else's eyes as well.

records.jp: みんなが花壇の花を楽しんでくれたら、<CR>嬉しいよね、詩さん！
records.en_original: Oh, it'd be so nice if everyone could appreciate what you've done with the garden, wouldn't it, Uta?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, it'd be so nice if everyone could appreciate what you've done with the garden, wouldn't it, Uta?
records.en: It would make you happy if everyone enjoyed<CR>the flowers in the flower bed, right, Uta-san!

records.jp: はい。美弦さんと陽桜莉さんに手伝ってもらって、<CR>ここまで育った花壇ですから
records.en_original: Yes. It was thanks to the help of these two that this garden has blossomed. I would enjoy sharing it with the others as well.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. It was thanks to the help of these two that this garden has blossomed. I would enjoy sharing it with the others as well.
records.en: Yes. After all, this flower bed got this far<CR>with Mio-san and Hiori-san helping me.

records.jp: それに、青い花って美弦さんにぴったりだしね
records.en_original: And blue flowers suit you so well, Mio.
records.en_auxiliary: And blue flowers suit you so well, Mio.
records.en: Besides, blue flowers suit you perfectly too, Mio-san.

records.en_original: Oh, me?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, me?
records.en: Huh, me...?

records.jp: 凛としてて、落ち着いてて……。<CR>強い自己主張はしないのに、存在感がある感じでさ
records.en_original: So elegant and serene... They have a strong presence, even without calling attention to themselves.
records.en_auxiliary: So elegant and serene... They have a strong presence, even without calling attention to themselves.
records.en: Dignified and calm...<CR>They do not assert themselves strongly, and yet they still have presence.

records.jp: あ、たしかにお姉ちゃんみたいだね！
records.en_original: Wow, that really does sound like Mio!
records.en_auxiliary: Wow, that really does sound like Mio!
records.en: Ah, that is true. That does sound like Onee-chan!

records.jp: 私、そんなに格好よくないけれど……
records.en_original: I don't think I'm that cool...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think I'm that cool...
records.en: I am not quite that cool, though...

records.jp: えっと……そうだなぁ。<CR>紫色の花とか良くない？
records.en_original: Hmm, I do like the idea of violet flowers.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, I do like the idea of purple flowers.
records.en: Um... Let me see.<CR>How about purple flowers?

records.jp: あ、それいいかも！<CR>この花壇にまだ無い色だし！
records.en_original: That would be great! We don't have any of those in the garden yet!
records.en_auxiliary: That would be great! We don't have any of those in the garden yet!
records.en: Ah, that might be nice!<CR>We do not have that color in this flower bed yet!

records.jp: それに紫色の花を選ぶのって、詩さんらしいなって<CR>なんかそう思うし
records.en_original: If anybody was going to suggest violet, I figured it would be you, Uta.
records.en_auxiliary: If anybody was going to suggest purple, I figured it would be you, Uta.
records.en: And somehow, choosing purple flowers<CR>feels very like you, Uta-san.

records.jp: 薄い紫色の小ぶりな花なら……強い主張も<CR>しませんし、邪魔にならないと思ったんです
records.en_original: I just thought some small violet flowers would be subtle and unintrusive.
records.en_auxiliary: I just thought some small purple flowers would be subtle and unintrusive.
records.en: If they were small, light purple flowers...<CR>they would not assert themselves too strongly, and I thought they would not get in the way.

records.jp: 邪魔な花なんて、ないよ。それに神秘的な感じが<CR>詩ちゃんに似合う気がするんだ～
records.en_original: There's no such thing as an intrusive flower, Uta. But I think the mystical vibe of violet flowers suits you.
records.en_auxiliary: There's no such thing as an intrusive flower, Uta. But I think the mystical vibe of purple flowers suits you.
records.en: There is no such thing as a flower that gets in the way.<CR>And besides, I feel like that mystical sort of feel suits you, Uta-chan~

records.jp: 私……ですか……？
records.en_original: It does...?
records.en_auxiliary: It does...?

records.jp: そうね。紫色の花はいろいろあるけれど、<CR>それだけに、いろいろな想像をかき立てる……
records.en_original: I agree. There are many different types of violet flowers, which stirs the imagination.
records.en_auxiliary: I agree. There are many different types of purple flowers, which stirs the imagination.
records.en: That is true. There are all sorts of purple flowers,<CR>and because of that, they stir all sorts of imaginings...

records.jp: その花次第で印象ががらりと変わる、<CR>決して他と埋没しない、自立した色の花よ
records.en_original: It is a striking hue that stands out against other flowers, changing the entire feel of a garden.
records.en_auxiliary: It is a striking hue that stands out against other flowers, changing the entire feel of a garden.
records.en: Depending on the flower, the impression changes completely.<CR>They are flowers with an independent color that never gets buried among the others.

records.jp: 中でも、小ぶりで薄い色の花を、あなたは選んだ。<CR>優しい気付きを与えてくれる、そんな花ね
records.en_original: But the flowers you chose are small, with only a faint violet hue. I find that a very considerate choice.
records.en_auxiliary: But the flowers you chose are small, with only a faint purple hue. I find that a very considerate choice.
records.en: And among them, you chose small, pale-colored flowers.<CR>Flowers that give people gentle realizations—flowers like that.

records.jp: あ！　それ、いまの詩ちゃんにぴったりだよね～！<CR>私も、すっごくいいと思うなぁ
records.en_original: Ooh! That's exactly like Uta! I think that'd be perfect!
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh! That's exactly like Uta! I think that'd be perfect!
records.en: Ah! That is exactly like the Uta-chan of now, isn't it~!?<CR>I think it would be really nice too.

records.jp: （このふたりは、私のことをそんな風に<CR>見ていてくれたの……）
records.en_original: (So this is how these two see me...)
records.en_auxiliary: (So this is how these two see me...)
records.en: (So that is how these two<CR>have been seeing me...)

records.jp: 私にそんな言葉が似合うとは、自分では思いません。<CR>でも……嬉しいです
records.en_original: I don't think such words suit someone like me, but...it does make me feel happy.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think such words suit someone like me, but...it does make me feel happy.
records.en: I do not think words like that suit me.<CR>But... I am happy.

records.jp: 新しい花、楽しみだなぁ。<CR>私も手伝っていい？
records.en_original: I can't wait to see the new flowers! Can I help too?
records.en_auxiliary: I can't wait to see the new flowers! Can I help too?
records.en: I am looking forward to the new flowers.<CR>Can I help too?

records.jp: もちろんだよ、愛央ちゃん！
records.en_original: Of course, Ao!
records.en_auxiliary: Of course, Ao!
records.en: Of course, Ao-chan!

records.jp: どの色の花を植えても、きっと素敵な花壇になる。<CR>それは確かだと思うわ
records.en_original: The garden will be beautiful no matter what color flowers we plant. I'm sure of it.
records.en_auxiliary: The garden will be beautiful no matter what color flowers we plant. I'm sure of it.
records.en: Whatever color flowers we plant, it is sure to become a lovely flower bed.<CR>I am certain of that.

records.jp: それじゃ、植える花の色を考えながら、<CR>まずは、ここの花たちに水やりをしましょうか
records.en_original: Well, let's water these flowers as we think about what color flowers to plant next.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, let's water these flowers as we think about what color flowers to plant next.
records.en: Then, as we think about what color flowers to plant,<CR>shall we first water the flowers here?

records.jp: ……そうですね
records.en_original: Yes, let's.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, let's.
records.en: ...Yes.

records.jp: ふふっ。楽しみだねぇ
records.en_original: Hehe. I can't wait!
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. I can't wait!
records.en: Heheh. I am looking forward to it.

records.jp: …………。<CR>……何だか、いいよねぇ。こういうの
records.en_original: You know... This is nice.
records.en_auxiliary: You know... This is nice.
records.en: ......<CR>...There is just something nice about this, isn't there?

records.jp: 私たち、ここに来なかったらさ、こんな風に<CR>一緒に花壇の水やりなんて、できなかったもんね
records.en_original: Had we not come here, we may never have found ourselves watering a garden full of flowers together.
records.en_auxiliary: Had we not come here, we may never have found ourselves watering a garden full of flowers together.
records.en: If we had not come here,<CR>we never would have been able to water a flower bed together like this.

records.jp: ……はい。<CR>今の私は、満たされている……と思います
records.en_original: True. I feel...content.
records.en_auxiliary: True. I feel...content.
records.en: ...Yes.<CR>I think... I am fulfilled now.

records.jp: （平凡な日常なんて、退屈だと思ってた）
records.en_original: (I used to think everyday life was nothing but a bore.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I used to think everyday life was nothing but a bore.)
records.en: (I used to think ordinary everyday life was boring.)

records.jp: （でも、こんな些細なことができる日々は、<CR>すごくかけがえのないものなんだ……）
records.en_original: (But the days that we do these mundane things are far more precious than I ever expected.)
records.en_auxiliary: (But the days that we do these mundane things are far more precious than I ever expected.)
records.en: (But the days where we can do little things like this<CR>are so very irreplaceable...)
